title: Tech Note: Mirroring with 4D 2004.4, Part II

historical_commentary.text: Only the teaser text for this Part II follow-up is available, but it describes a revised, more robust and error-handled implementation of a database mirroring system built on commands 4D introduced in version 2004.3, explicitly incompatible with the original Part I code. Database mirroring/replication remains a conceptually relevant topic, but the specific 2004.3/2004.4-era mirroring commands and component this note relies on are long superseded by 4D's later built-in replication and Backup/Log-based mechanisms.
related_updates: 4D has since introduced more integrated backup, log, and replication capabilities in later versions, superseding ad hoc 2004-era mirroring commands and custom components
